game.name: Google Snake
game.rules:
All runs must include the in-game timer, which is enabled by pressing the ‘T’ key on the keyboard. All runs require video proof and the video must be above 15 FPS. Split timer must be easily readable

Your video must include the first frame of the run (0:00:000 on the timer) or footage of the reset leading to this run, given the snake hasn't moved more than 2 tiles at the start.

Your board must be fully in view, including the score counter and timer. If you have used a modified board (i.e. using Custom Theme), there must be a distinguishable difference between the game elements and the game board.

Runs on third-party websites are invalid, except https://googlesnakemods.com/ which is maintained by community modders.

You can play the official version of the game by searching 'snake game', ‘google snake’, or similar search terms on Google. Alternatively, you can go to: https://www.google.com/fbx?fbx=snake_arcade

Mobile runs will be rejected unless they are using the "Desktop site".

Runs recorded using a separate device need to have a good view of the screen.

“Pudding Mod" from the Mod Loader is the only allowed mod as it only changes the game visually and doesn’t grant any competitive advantage. All other mods, including “More Pudding Mod”, are banned and runs using them will be rejected.

No cheating, obviously

newsList.title: Slow Runs Moved To Base Game!
newsList.body:
The mod team are happy to announce that all slow runs have officially been moved from Category Extensions to the Base Game, meaning if you want to submit a slow speed run, you'll now need to submit to the Base Game, not Category Extensions.

We'd like to give a HUGE thanks to Maximum from the Red Ba

Runs recorded using a separate device need to have a good view of the screen.

Other mods, besides Pudding Mod in the Game Loader are only allowed for specific categories. Make sure you read the category rules to make sure you are using the correct mod for the category.

No cheating, obviously

i put a solid effort, about 40k attempts for this but it was enjoyable since i like the category. this really is the holy grail of google snake records and i'm proud to now be among those before me to hold it. 

beating this will not be easy. its not gonna happen overnight. but i wish the very best to those few who will truly dedicate themselves to this.

yarmi is getting tired so lets wrap it up, happy april fools lads (look at the date of the run)
